about: The released combination of the shared suite (E2E-1, .github/workflows/suite.yml). A candidate replaces its own component; the others are built from the commits here. Change it in a pull request after a release, then move the pin of suite.yml in the callers of Status Board and Security Monitor to the merged commit. package is informational for now: the suite builds every component from its commit and records whether the .deb has the bytes of the release.
combination: M1: Status Board 0.4.0, Host Settings 0.3.0, Security Monitor 0.4.1
